India-New Zealand 3rd ODI Abandoned Due to Rain

The third One Day International (ODI) cricket match between India and New Zealand, scheduled to be played in Hamilton, was called off due to persistent rain. The toss was delayed, and ultimately the match could not proceed. India retains its 2-0 lead in the five-match series.
